interpretation.influence_checks: Diagnostic omission only; neither records nor reported inferential families are removed or changed.
interpretation.matched_block: One dataset/seed/generator generated baseline and all six matched relabeled comparisons are omitted together, avoiding baseline reuse as independent evidence.
interpretation.seed_projections: Conditional scenarios holding true means and estimated variance components fixed; two observed seeds cannot establish reliable forecasts. New experiments may change both.
interpretation.infinite_seed_limit: Population-task mean retains dataset variation even when within-task run noise tends to zero. Fixed seed blocks condition on the studied seeds; seed-population variation is not estimated.
interpretation.data_caveats: MNIST12/28 share a task family; documented MNIST12 TVAE holdout-feature collisions remain. Influence arithmetic cannot rule out experimental or provenance problems.
